name: STACO
source: STACO Insurance Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2020, consolidated and separate statement of financial position, printed page 47 (file _ngx_pdf/STACO.pdf), separate (company) column, and the five year financial summary - company, printed page 124. Filing in NGN thousands, stored here in absolute NGN. CRON 20260929_183159: FY2020 and FY2019 now carry the printed company totals 2,114,449 and 2,466,192 (assets), 11,160,507 and 10,300,032 (liabilities), (9,046,058) and (7,833,840) (equity); assets less liabilities equals equity on both years exactly. The earlier FY2020 total assets (3,693,126) was the GROUP 2019 column, and the earlier FY2019 total liabilities (10,300,320) had two digits transposed against the printed 10,300,032. The FY2018 to FY2016 figures were repeats of the 2019 and 2020 columns under older year labels and no audited report for those years is on hand, so they are withheld rather than shown.
